# 黃帝陰符經註--張果

**ID:** KR5a0113
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0113

## Authors / Editors
- 張果 8th cent 前半

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An eleven-folio Táng commentary on the *[Huángdì yīnfú jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0031)* by the celebrated Daoist Zhāng Guǒ 張果, recorded in *[DZ 295 Xù xiān zhuàn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0295)* 2.4b–6a as having died at the beginning of the Tiānbǎo period (742–756). Since the commentary mentions neither the title nor *hào* that were bestowed on Zhāng by the emperor in 734 (cf. *Jiù Táng shū* 8.200), it was probably written before that date. Zhāng Guǒ's biography in *Jiù Táng shū* 191 records that he wrote the *Yīnfú jīng xuánjiě* 陰符經玄解; in the Sòng catalogues, the present text is listed under the title *Yīnfú jīng tàiwú zhuàn* 陰符經太無傳 (see VDL 140).

Zhāng mentions in his preface that several commentaries to the *Yīnfú jīng* existed already; he wrote his specifically to refute Lǐ Quán 李筌's *[DZ 109 Jízhù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0109)* — making this commentary an early example within the Daozang of direct commentarial polemic between contemporary Táng Daoist authorities.

**Abstract**

Florian C. Reiter, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:693 (§3.A.1), dates the commentary to before 734 (since it does not mention Zhāng's 734 imperial title). The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 700 / notAfter 734, with dynasty 唐. Zhāng Guǒ is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
